title: "Data"
subtitle: "What we used, for which test, and what stays on our laptops"
lang: en-IN
---

Every number on this site comes from one of the datasets below. The files in the first column are our own summaries; raw lists with names, and licensed data, never leave our laptops.

| Dataset | Years | Used for | Public summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Census migration by reason, sex and distance (D-03) | 2001, 2011 | The gravity test and the distance bands | `census_female_share_by_band.csv`, `census_gravity_results.csv` |
| Maharashtra CAP allotment lists, names dropped at parsing | 2023-2025 | The same-score gap, by band, inside the same college | `mh_cap_tests.csv`, `mh_cap_oaxaca.csv` |
| JoSAA closing ranks | 2016-2025 | The closing-rank null; the twins' seats | `trend_by_year.csv`, `trend_tests.csv`, `bhu_shock_event_study.csv`, `bhu_shock_placebo.csv` |
| CSAB empty-seat lists and JoSAA seat matrices | 2025-2026 | Empty women-only against open seats, by NIT | `vacancy_gap_by_nit_2025_2026.csv`, `vacancy_tests.csv` |
| NIT airport distance and hill flag | 2025-2026 | The airport test | `last_mile_buckets.csv`, `last_mile_test_coefs.csv` |
| NIRF median salary of UG graduates | 2024-2025 | The value term; near against far by state | `nirf_median_salary.csv`, `state_pay_near_vs_far.csv` |
| JEE Main registered, qualified and allotted, by gender | 2013-2026 | The funnel figure | `jee_funnel_by_year.csv` |
| Rail and air fares and hours, three Bihar homes | 19 Nov 2026 | Money and reach time in the model | in the model file, typed from the listed pages |
| Reddit posts and comments, tagged by hand | 2017-2026 | Quotes and counts of who decides | counts only; no usernames |

: Datasets and the summary files you can download {#tbl-datasets}

The summary files are in the site's `data/` folder, one CSV each. The figures on the [figures page](../figures/) are drawn from them. The two RTI requests are on [their own page](../rti/).

# What we keep off the site

- Admission lists, even with names dropped: raw files stay local.
- The scanned RTI replies, which carry a personal address. The [RTI page](../rti/) summarises them in text.
- Social media usernames.
- Licensed databases: only our own summary tables are public.
